steps.en: Officer picks email as the channel and a recipient
steps.id: Petugas memilih email sebagai saluran dan penerima

steps.en: A list of standard email templates is offered for the rejection
steps.id: Daftar template email standar ditawarkan untuk penolakan
steps.why_en: The template wording is stored outside the code, so it cannot be confirmed that every rejection template is loaded.
steps.why_id: Isi template tersimpan di luar code, jadi tidak bisa dipastikan semua template penolakan sudah dimuat.

steps.en: Picking a template fills in the subject and body automatically
steps.id: Memilih template mengisi subject dan isi email otomatis

steps.en: Officer can freely rewrite the subject and message
steps.id: Petugas bisa menulis ulang subject dan pesan dengan bebas

steps.en: The customised email is queued and then sent to the recipient
steps.id: Email yang sudah disesuaikan masuk antrean lalu dikirim ke penerima
